name: 数据简报
description: 报告蓝 #0F4C81 + 琥珀点缀，深底反白表头，为数据密集型内容设计：日报、榜单、模型对比

styles.h1: font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; color: #ffffff; text-align: left; background: #0F4C81; border-left: 6px solid #F59E0B; border-radius: 4px; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 16px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.h2: display: flex; align-items: center; border-bottom: 3px solid #0F4C81; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: bold; color: #0F4C81; border-left: 4px solid #F59E0B; margin-top: 28px; margin-bottom: 10px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h4: font-size: 16px; font-weight: bold; color: #1F2937; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h5: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #374151; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.h6: font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: #6B7280; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.3;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #2D3748; line-height: 1.78; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 20px; letter-spacing: 0.5px; text-align: justify;
styles.blockquote: border-left: 4px solid #0F4C81; background: rgba(15,76,129,0.06); margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 16px; border-radius: 0 6px 6px 0; font-size: 15px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.75;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 14px; color: #334155; line-height: 1.75; margin-bottom: 0; letter-spacing: 0.3px; font-style: normal; background: transparent;
styles.a: color: #0F4C81; text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(15,76,129,0.3);
styles.img: max-width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(15,76,129,0.1); background: #ffffff; margin-top: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(to right, #0F4C81, #F59E0B); border: none;
styles.code: background: rgba(15,76,129,0.08); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 90%; color: #0F4C81; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.pre: background: #F8FAFC; border-radius: 0; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0; border-top: 3px solid #0F4C81; color: #1E293B; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; word-break: break-all;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; background: #EFF3F8;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #1E293B; font-size: 14px; font-family: Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, 'Courier New', monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border-spacing: 0; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #E2E8F0;
styles.th: background: #0F4C81; border: none; text-align: left; font-weight: bold; color: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; min-width: 22px; background: #0F4C81; color: #ffffff; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: bold; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 4px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #2D3748; line-height: 1.78; letter-spacing: 0.5px; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
styles.footnotes li: font-size: 13px; color: #64748B; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.6; word-break: break-all;
